title: Clean empty local encoded folders
summary: Add guarded periodic cleanup for empty local encoded-output directories under LocalBase\Encoded.
reason: Successful publish removes local encoded media files but can leave empty title/show folders under the local staging root. Those empty folders create operator-visible clutter and waste directory entries without preserving useful media evidence.
behavior_before: Pipeline startup cleaned old processing temp files, src_* scratch-copy folders, stale .mp-partial files, and old .mediapipeline-staging directories, but empty LocalBase\Encoded title/show folders were left behind after successful publish.
behavior_after: Pipeline startup forces an empty LocalBase\Encoded folder cleanup, and completed queue rounds invoke the same cleanup no more than hourly. Cleanup removes only empty directories under LocalBase\Encoded that are older than CleanupStaleAgeHours, skips .mediapipeline-staging, preserves files and fresh/non-empty folders, and fails closed when LocalEncoded is outside LocalBase.
tests_added: Extended ops/pipeline/tests/Unit/Invoke-PathBoundaryGuardChecks.ps1 to prove stale empty LocalBase\Encoded folders are removed, fresh folders, non-empty folders, files, staging folders, and the LocalEncoded root are preserved, and LocalEncoded outside LocalBase fails closed.
